facts.business: Simmonds Marshall Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of industrial fasteners.

segments.name: Other operating revenue (export incentives, scrap sales)

key_risks: Commodity Price Volatility: Fluctuations in steel, alloy and crude-oil-linked input prices can impact input costs and margins.
Supply Chain Disruptions: Geopolitical tensions - particularly the ongoing West Asia conflict - trade policy shifts, and global uncertainties may affect raw material availability and freight costs.
Regulatory Changes: Evolving environmental and safety norms require agility in adapting products and processes.
Weather-Related Risks: Extreme weather conditions or monsoon variability can impact rural demand, indirectly affecting auto demand.
Exchange Rate Volatility: While the rupee has shown resilience, global financial uncertainties may lead to volatility.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has taken land and building on lease from a related party (J.N. Marshall & Company (Engg Dept.)) for a period of 49 years. During the year, the Company received approval from MIDC for execution of a sub-lease for 13,000 sq. mtrs. forming part of Plot No. C-4/1, Chakan Industrial Area Phase II, originally sub-leased from the related party, and paid a differential premium of Rs. 101.07 lakhs to MIDC, treated as lease modification cost and capitalised.
